li.quietText: The pulse goes into the Dark and nothing comes back but stone.

li.label: something heavy walking
li.reading: A slow footfall the pulse catches twice: something big is crossing the crags out of sight.

li.label: sorter workings
li.reading: Small square echoes laid out in rows: someone has been stacking things very neatly.

li.label: storm-torn turbine
li.reading: A long metal ring, and somewhere inside it a bearing still turning.

li.label: pocket in the rock
li.reading: The echo falls into a pocket of the Dark that the rock closes over.

li.quietText: Clean ice all the way down, ringing like a struck glass. Nothing in it but cold.

li.label: something rising through the ice
li.reading: A deep crack note, and under it a slow push from below. The ice there is thinning.

li.label: something lying under the drift
li.reading: A soft dead spot in the ice-sand, the shape of a body that does not want to be found.

li.label: ice-locked wreck
li.reading: Hollow metal held stiff in the ice: a hull, frozen where it fell.

li.label: blue ice
li.reading: A denser, purer ring than the grain around it: old blue ice, close under the surface.

li.quietText: Only the forest's own wet engine noise, rising and falling. Nothing answers it.

li.label: vent
li.reading: A roar under the ground that rises and falls like breath, too regular for the weather.

li.label: something listening back
li.reading: The ground's own noise stops for a moment, the way a held breath stops. Something heard the pulse.

li.label: resin boils
li.reading: Thick, slow, sticky echoes from cracks in the stone: resin welling where nobody can see it.

li.label: void in the rock
li.reading: The echo drops into a hollow under the forest floor.

li.quietText: Wet, warm noise and the storm overhead. Nothing in the ground is growing any faster than the rest.

li.label: something growing
li.reading: One deep wet heartbeat, too large for any animal, and getting slowly larger.

li.label: gestation pods
li.reading: A cluster of small thick echoes, each with something soft and moving inside it.

li.label: eroded wreckage
li.reading: Thin, pitted metal: whatever fell here, the land is still eating it.

li.label: hollow under the mud
li.reading: The pulse finds a hollow under the red ground, and it is warm.

li.quietText: Mud and root and still water, deep and quiet. Nothing under the pools is awake.

li.label: something in the pool
li.reading: Under a mirror pool, a long coil shifts its weight and goes still again.

li.label: living heartwood
li.reading: A slow wet pulse deep inside a trunk: the one part of the tree that never goes still.

li.label: kurreth tunnels
li.reading: Packed, resin-hard plugs in the ground, and empty runs between them.

li.label: overgrown wreck
li.reading: Metal under the roots, wrapped tight and ringing dull.

li.quietText: Steam, roots and running water. The jungle is loud, and none of it is hiding.

li.label: greatbole heart
li.reading: A slow wet beat deep inside the wood, much slower than any animal's.

li.label: hollow trunk
li.reading: A huge hollow note: a fallen or dead trunk, empty inside.

li.label: skerrel galls
li.reading: Papery rattles where the sap runs thickest. The galls are full.

li.label: something lying in wait
li.reading: A long, still body in the undergrowth that does not move when the pulse goes by.

li.quietText: Brine and salt, heavy and still. The pulse comes back muffled, and nothing in it moved.

li.label: something caught in the salt
li.reading: A shape inside a block of salt that rings wrong, as if it was once alive.

li.label: great salt crystals
li.reading: Clean, high crystal notes from the deep floor.

li.label: salt chimney
li.reading: A slow plume of heavy brine sinking out of a tower of salt.

li.label: something vast and slow
li.reading: A huge, slow body with a whole reef growing on it.

li.quietText: Brackish water and soft roots, deadened by the salt. Nothing in the channels is any bigger than it looks.

li.label: nursery shallows
li.reading: Many small quick echoes in the brine shallows, and one larger, slower one keeping watch.

li.label: young things in the channel mud
li.reading: Small hard shells and soft bodies in the channel mud, a lot of them.

li.label: brined flotsam
li.reading: Salt-crusted metal thrown up by a surge, hollow and ringing dull.

li.label: void under the roots
li.reading: The echo falls into a hollow under the stilt roots.

li.quietText: Dirty ice, slowly flowing, and nothing in it but what it already swallowed long ago.

li.label: something breaking through
li.reading: A fresh crack note with a push under it: something is coming up through the ice.

li.label: frost-locked wreck
li.reading: Hollow metal locked hard in the ice, exactly as it came down.

li.label: void in the ice
li.reading: The echo falls into a pocket the ice has closed over.

li.quietText: Deck plate under deck plate, ringing the same note forever.

li.label: dead smartsteel
li.reading: A patterned ring inside the plate, as if the metal were still trying to answer.

li.label: sacred conduit
li.reading: A wall that hums back at you, just slightly out of tune with the pulse.

li.label: something living in the metal
li.reading: A small clicking echo moving along the inside of a wall.

li.label: void in the deck
li.reading: The pulse falls into an empty chamber below the deck plate.

li.quietText: Slag and broken floor, picked clean. Nothing down there but the old war's dust.

li.label: unexploded shell
li.reading: A dense, hard, pointed echo in the slag. Do not dig carelessly.

li.label: kneeling machines
li.reading: Heavy, quiet metal, folded down where it stopped.

li.label: hollow behind a wall
li.reading: A thin hollow ring behind an old wall panel: there is a space back there.

li.label: stripped wreck
li.reading: The bare ribs of a fallen warship, ringing hollow.

li.label: bunker void
li.reading: The echo drops into a sealed space under the old line.

li.quietText: The body hums back at the same pitch everywhere. Nothing in it is any bigger than the rest.

li.label: something vast in the body
li.reading: The whole ground answers late, as if something huge had to turn round first.

li.label: liquid slime
li.reading: A soft, swallowing note: the crust is thin here and the body underneath is still liquid.

li.label: readerblooms
li.reading: Pale discs somewhere ahead all turn at once to face the pulse.

li.label: hollow in the body
li.reading: The pulse falls into a hollow the body has closed over.

li.quietText: Tar, flat and black, swallowing the pulse without a ripple.

li.label: something under the tar
li.reading: A rise in the tar answers late and heavy. Something big is lying just under the surface.

li.label: still hunter
li.reading: A body as still as the glass sheet around it, and warmer.

li.label: thrummel brood
li.reading: Many soft echoes clustered round one larger body.

li.label: void under the sheet
li.reading: The echo drops into a hollow under the cooled glass.

li.quietText: Basalt and pumice, hot and dense. The mountain is not hiding anything close to the surface.

li.label: magma close under the crust
li.reading: A thick, slow roar where the crust is thin. The heat is very close here.

li.label: floatstone garden
li.reading: A strangely light, glassy chiming: spun stone, growing out of the crust.

li.label: something plated and heavy
li.reading: A heavy, glassy footfall on the shingle somewhere out of sight.

li.label: lava tube
li.reading: The echo runs a long way down an empty tube in the rock.

li.quietText: Soft, spongy echoes from the fungal floor. Nothing in it is bigger than the mat itself.

li.label: something with a full gut
li.reading: A huge, slow gut noise, and inside it a single metal ring.

li.label: thozzik colony
li.reading: A honeycomb of small echoes, all moving, and one larger one at the middle.

li.label: digested wreck
li.reading: Metal gone soft at the edges, half eaten by the Rot.

li.label: hollow under the mat
li.reading: The pulse falls into a hollow under the fungal mat.

li.quietText: The boil drowns everything. Under the roar there is nothing the pulse can pick out.

li.label: scald vent
li.reading: A deep pulse of steam from a vent on the shore, coming and going on its own rhythm.

li.label: something walking the floor
li.reading: A hundred short heavy legs moving across the boiling floor.

li.label: scalded wreck
li.reading: Metal cooked clean in the shallows, ringing thin.

li.label: bladderboils
li.reading: Leathery sacs riding the boil, swelling and emptying.

li.quietText: Under the waveglass the water is quiet, and every light in it is telling the truth.

li.label: fallen pane
li.reading: A broad flat sheet of the lid lying on the floor, still ringing from its fall.

li.label: skylight
li.reading: A thin place in the lid overhead, where the pulse leaks out.

li.label: something very big in the dark
li.reading: A body as long as a hull, moving slowly at the edge of the light.

li.label: a light that lies
li.reading: One gold light answers the pulse a moment too late. Lamps do not do that.

li.quietText: Salt, ash and fallout, all of it lying where it fell. Nothing moves under it.

li.label: middenshell
li.reading: A colossal, slow grinding echo, and heat with it. Something the size of a hill is moving.

li.label: brine beds
li.reading: Crisp mineral crackles under the pool floor, and small things moving in them.

li.label: irradiated wreck
li.reading: Hollow metal lying in the ash, still warm.

li.label: void in the rock
li.reading: The pulse falls into a hollow under the waste.

li.quietText: Silk and root and stolen water. The thicket churns, and none of it is hiding.

li.label: urraveth remains
li.reading: Huge bones wrapped in silk, ringing hollow and muffled at once.

li.label: nest
li.reading: A thick, packed echo, and inside it many small leathery ones.

li.label: ollathrix
li.reading: Something with a lot of legs, very still, holding a line taut.

li.label: void under the roots
li.reading: The pulse falls into a hollow under the root mat.

li.quietText: Dry stone and wet seep, the same pale rock all the way down.

li.label: ancient condenser
li.reading: A square machine echo in the rock, with water moving through it.

li.label: breathing vent
li.reading: A soft rush of warm air through a crack, in and out.

li.label: seep curtain
li.reading: Wet, dripping echoes on a shaded face: water coming out of the stone.

li.label: cistern
li.reading: The echo drops into a cool hollow in the stone, and it sounds wet.

li.quietText: Cold fuel, black and still. The pulse sinks into it and nothing answers.

li.label: stonewater
li.reading: A hard, bone-white ring on the floor: water, frozen hard as granite.

li.label: something cutting a wake
li.reading: A long body moving fast and low just under the surface.

li.label: wax colony
li.reading: A slow file of heavy waxy bodies crossing the floor, eating.

li.label: eldspar garden
li.reading: A fine, high crystal ringing from the deep floor.

li.quietText: Wind and fuzz and root-bound crust, the same in every direction.

li.label: something under the root crust
li.reading: A dull thud under the fuzz, then another one further on. It is moving.

li.label: sweetline tree
li.reading: Deep, wet roots, much deeper than anything else here: one old tree drinking.

li.label: hollow venomvine
li.reading: A stand of empty cane tubes, ringing like pipes.

li.label: void in the rock
li.reading: The echo drops into a hollow under the crust.

li.quietText: Hot rock and drifted sand. Everything that lives here is already in the shade, and none of it is hiding.

li.label: something enormous lying still
li.reading: A huge body lying very still in a shadow. It does not move when the pulse goes by.

li.label: midden heap
li.reading: A soft, layered echo in the lee of a rock: years of windblown leavings, and things in them.

li.label: wrecked cart
li.reading: Wood and iron, half drowned in sand: a cart left where it broke.

li.label: cool hollow
li.reading: The pulse finds a cool, shaded hollow inside the rock.

li.quietText: Wind and sand noise, and under it nothing: the dunes lie still all the way down.

li.label: something moving under the sand
li.reading: Under the hiss, a low rumble you feel in your teeth. It is not where it was a moment ago.

li.label: buried cache
li.reading: A hard, hollow ring inside a drift: something made, and sealed, under the sand.

li.label: brood chamber
li.reading: A honeycomb of small echoes: tunnels, and many things in them.

li.label: cave
li.reading: The pulse falls into a long, cool emptiness inside the rock.

li.quietText: Frozen ammonia and fuel snow. The pulse comes back clean and cold.

li.label: something that never stops burning
li.reading: A heat in the ice that the cold never touches, moving slowly.

li.label: rime nodules
li.reading: Small hard beads in the fuel, each holding something liquid.

li.label: void in the ice
li.reading: The echo falls into a pocket under the frozen flats.

li.quietText: Sediment-heavy water all the way down. Rock, and nothing in it.

li.label: void in the bed
li.reading: The echo drops into a hollow under the sediment.

li.quietText: Frozen ammonia and fuel snow. The pulse comes back clean and cold.

li.label: something that never stops burning
li.reading: A heat in the ice that the cold never touches, moving slowly.

li.label: rime nodules
li.reading: Small hard beads in the fuel, each holding something liquid.

li.label: void in the ice
li.reading: The echo falls into a pocket under the frozen flats.
